responsibility: This file declares the command-line options accepted by the MIPS port and the variables or masks they control. It defines ABI, ISA, processor tuning, floating-point ABI, ASE enablement, erratum workarounds, code-model, scheduling, branch, and target-specific optimization options, together with the enumerations and help text needed by GCC’s option parser and driver, making it the authoritative option specification for the backend.
same_name_distinction: Within the mips same-name group, this file is the option-table specification consumed by GCC’s option machinery: it declares MIPS target switches, enums, masks, and help text, rather than backend code in mips.cc, target macros/types in mips.h, or RTL instruction patterns in mips.md.
